jobs.title: Client Onboarding Concierge
jobs.description:
**THE ROLE**


We are looking for an Client Onboarding Concierge to help new customers successfully move through the first steps of their journey with us.


This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role with a strong focus on phone communication, fast response times, and consistent follow\-up.


You will welcome new customers, help them book their required calls, guide them through basic setup and activation steps, follow up when actions are incomplete, and make sure they are prepared and ready for onboarding.


You will not deliver the formal Intro or Onboarding calls. Your job is to make sure customers are contacted, booked, prepared, supported, and moving forward.

**THE COMPANY**


A multi\-8\-figure ARR business with 200\+ team members, bootstrapped and profitable. The company launches and scales information and software products on a marketing and sales engine refined across a dozen product launches and $100M\+ in ad spend.


This seat sits inside the onboarding org, dedicated to a fast\-growing product line. Your job is to make sure customers who come in the door finish, renew, and refer.


What You Will Do:

* Contact new customers quickly after they purchase, with a target of making the first phone attempt within 30 minutes
* Welcome customers and explain their next steps
* Book and confirm Intro and Onboarding calls directly with customers
* Follow up consistently by phone, SMS, and email when customers do not respond
* Help customers access our platforms and complete required setup and preparation before their calls
* Follow up with customers who miss appointments and help get them rebooked
* Resolve simple login, booking, and platform issues
* Escalate more complex customer concerns to the appropriate team
* Keep accurate notes and records of customer interactions, progress, and next steps
* Continue following up until the customer successfully progresses through onboarding

  

**Requirements**  

What We're Looking For:

* Strong spoken and written English
* Confident and comfortable speaking with customers by phone
* Previous experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Appointment Setting, Onboarding, or a similar client\-facing role
* Friendly, professional, and patient communication style
* Persistent with follow\-up without being pushy
* Strong organisation and attention to detail
* Comfortable using CRM systems and learning new technology
* Able to manage multiple customers and priorities at the same time
* Reliable, coachable, and comfortable working toward clear performance targets

  

**Benefits**  

* Full\-time opportunity
* Independent Contractor Agreement
* $2,000 USD monthly base
* Up to $1,000 USD monthly variable compensation
* Fully remote
* Opportunity to grow into broader Customer Success, Onboarding, or leadership roles

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Uplinq**

  

Uplinq is the AI\-powered bookkeeping and tax automation platform built for small business owners. We’re re\-engineering how entrepreneurs manage their finances, replacing manual bookkeeping, rules, and spreadsheets with intelligent automation that delivers real\-time clarity and control.

  

We’re a Series A startup backed by top investors, growing fast. Our team is lean, execution\-focused, and allergic to fluff. We measure success in demos booked, pipelines created, and revenue influenced.

 **Individual applicants residing in the US only**  

  

**About the role**


As a Senior Onboarding Accounting Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for new Uplinq clients — guiding them through system setup, data clean\-up, and account activation.


This is a high\-touch, high\-volume role: you'll juggle a large, active portfolio of clients at different onboarding stages, which means the job rewards people who communicate early and often, adapt quickly when something isn't working, and hold themselves accountable for outcomes rather than just effort.


The right candidate will have a magnetic presence on calls and an excitement about interaction with small business owners. The ideal candidate is a person the clients look forward to speaking with, someone who makes them feel confident in the investment they’ve made when choosing Uplinq.

 **What you'll do**

* Lead daily client meetings to gather financial data, clarify scope, and build trust from the first call — earning it through rapport, clarity, and follow\-through, not just technical accuracy.
* Set up and configure Uplinq and QuickBooks Online accounts, including resolving integration and access issues (Plaid connections, payroll, revenue processors, inventory systems, etc) so systems sync cleanly from day one.
* Compare signed proposals to actual client needs in the first call, and flag scope or pricing mismatches immediately — to sales, to your manager, and directly to the client — rather than letting a gap surface later and erode trust.
* Manage a high volume of onboarding timelines and deliverables simultaneously, and proactively speak up when your workload or a specific account is at risk of falling behind, so it can be addressed before it becomes a bigger problem.
* Troubleshoot setup and data issues using sound accounting judgment, and treat mistakes as fast information rather than something to hide — surface them quickly, learn from them, and adjust.
* Find workarounds to keep stalled onboardings moving — manual data entry when a feed breaks, alternate document paths, creative scheduling — because an on\-time, good\-enough solution beats a stalled account waiting for a perfect one.
* Collaborate with Sales, Initialization, Accounting, and Tax teams to resolve handoff gaps, own your part of the process end\-to\-end, and transition accounts smoothly into ongoing support.

 **Qualifications**

* 6\+ years in a client\-facing accounting or onboarding role, ideally in public or multi\-client accounting firm as Senior Associate level or higher
* 6\+ years of daily QuickBooks use including Online setup, integrations, and troubleshooting (not desktop).
* Strong working knowledge of both cash\- and accrual\-based accounting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage 25\+ active client relationships at once without letting communication or follow\-through slip — someone who escalates early, adapts on the fly, and takes ownership of outcomes rather than absorbing pressure silently.
* A warm, confident, and memorable presence with clients — someone who builds real rapport fast, puts anxious business owners at ease, and makes a technical process feel personal rather than transactional.
* Comfortable having direct conversations with clients about scope and pricing when what they signed doesn't match what they need, and willing to admit and correct course quickly when something's off.

 **Why Join Us**

* Competitive pay \+ health, dental, vision, 401(k), and life insurance
* Remote\-first and flexible work culture
* Clear path for career growth in a fast\-growing firm
* Modern tech stack and automation\-first mindset
* Supportive, collaborative team with strong systems and documentation

  

Compensation Range: $75,000\-$85,000

 **The pay range for this role is:**  

75,000 \- 85,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Contract Full-Stack Developer / Server Deployment Specialist Milestone-Based Compensation
jobs.description:
**Company:** Axis International Group  
**Job Type:** Contract / Project\-Based  
**Location:** **United States Only — Remote**  
**Compensation:** Milestone\-Based \+ Completion Bonus / Potential Percentage

About the Position

Axis International Group is seeking an experienced **Full\-Stack Developer / Programmer / Server Deployment Specialist** to work with us on a contract, project\-by\-project basis.

We are developing and expanding a sophisticated business technology platform and are looking for someone capable of taking projects from **development through deployment and production**.

This position is ideal for an experienced developer who can work independently, solve problems, work with existing code, and handle Linux\-based server deployment and configuration.

Responsibilities

* Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and optimize web applications
* Work with existing codebases and APIs
* Build frontend and backend functionality
* Deploy applications to Linux\-based VPS/server environments
* Configure servers, databases, DNS, SSL, and related services
* Manage Git/GitHub repositories and deployments
* Integrate third\-party APIs and services
* Troubleshoot application, server, database, and networking problems
* Perform security, backup, and system\-maintenance tasks
* Document development and deployment procedures
* Work directly with company leadership to turn concepts into functioning technology
* Take ownership of assigned projects from beginning to completion

Preferred Technical Experience

Experience with several of the following:

* JavaScript / TypeScript
* React / Next.js
* Node.js
* Python and/or PHP
* REST APIs
* SQL databases
* Linux administration
* VPS/server deployment
* Git / GitHub
* Docker
* Nginx / Apache
* DNS and SSL
* Cloud infrastructure
* API integrations
* System troubleshooting and debugging

**We are more interested in your ability to solve problems and deliver working systems than in a specific list of certifications.**

Compensation

This is a **contract/project\-based position**, not a traditional hourly employment position.

Compensation will generally be structured around **project milestones**, allowing payments to be made as work progresses.

Depending on the project, compensation may include:

* Initial project payment
* Milestone payments
* Final completion payment
* Completion/performance bonus
* **Percentage\-based compensation or revenue participation on qualifying projects**

The specific compensation structure will be negotiated and agreed upon **before work begins on each project**.

Background \& Employment Verification

Because this position may involve access to **company systems, servers, source code, databases, proprietary technology, and confidential business information**, candidates must be willing to undergo a **full background check** as part of the selection process, subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws.

We will also **verify employment history and contact previous employers/references** to confirm relevant experience, responsibilities, and professional performance.

Providing false or misleading information regarding your employment history, qualifications, or experience may result in disqualification.

U.S. Applicants Only

**This is a United States–based position.**

Applicants **must currently reside in the United States**.

We are not accepting applicants who reside outside the United States for this position.

The Person We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

* Experienced and technically capable
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently
* Reliable and responsive
* Comfortable working with existing systems and unfamiliar code
* Capable of troubleshooting without constant supervision
* Security\-conscious
* Able to communicate clearly with non\-technical leadership
* Willing to take ownership of projects
* Interested in developing an ongoing working relationship with the company

**If you're the kind of developer who can be handed a problem and say, "I'll figure it out," we want to hear from you.**

How to Apply

Please provide:

* A brief description of your development experience
* Programming languages and technologies you specialize in
* Your Linux/server deployment experience
* Examples or links to projects you've developed or deployed
* Your experience working on a contract/project basis
* Your preferred milestone\-payment arrangement
* Your availability to begin
* At least **two professional references or previous employers** who can verify your work

**Contract • U.S.\-Based • Remote • Project\-Based • Milestone Compensation • Long\-Term Opportunity**

Pay: Up to $150,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
